name: Claude Migration
description: Imports Claude Code and Claude Desktop instructions, MCP servers, skills, and safe configuration into OpenClaw.
recommendedPrompts: Help me preview a migration from Claude Code or Claude Desktop to OpenClaw. Ask which local source or project to inspect, use the supported dry-run flow, and summarize the instructions, MCP definitions, and skills that would be imported. Show conflicts and sensitive-item warnings without applying changes or revealing credentials.

Help me plan a Claude migration without overwriting my current OpenClaw setup. Ask which source and agent to target, separate supported imports from archive-only hooks, permissions, and opaque credentials, and explain backup and verification steps. Do not reset state, import secrets, or apply the migration until I explicitly approve.
